newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia rejects bids for steel mill, talks go on.
newsitem.headline: Croatia rejects bids for steel mill, talks go on.

text.p: Croatia has rejected bids for Metaval, a unit of ailing steel mill Zeljezara Sisak after an extended tender, company officials said on Friday.
"The (tender) commission has reviewed materials and decided that there were no acceptable offers," director Stjepan Paulin told Reuters.
Another source said there were only two bidders in the international tender that expired at the end of September.
Zeljezara Sisak, valued at roughly 240 million German marks four years ago, is highly indebted but Metaval was offered for sale clear of all debts.
Paulin said talks would continue with an interested party, though they were expected to take quite a while. He declined to name the company and would only say it was European.

Metaval is the country's main producer of steel and steel semi-products, strips, billets, seamless and welded hot- and cold-rolled tubes and pipes. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
